name: Cumulative-Frequency-Equivalence
description: Replaces the Exact Cover requirement ("all chosen values must be distinct") with a mathematically equivalent condition on the cumulative frequency distribution: demanding that exactly k-x+1 chosen elements are >= x for all x in 1..k. Because elements are bounded by k, this mathematically forces exactly one of each value to be present. Models relying on surface pattern-matching will fail to recognize the exact cover structure, implement the condition literally without pruning the search space, and fail via Time Limit Exceeded.
